# WMF

> Premium German kitchenware and tableware manufacturer offering cookware, cutlery, coffee machines, and kitchen appliances through their official online shop.

WMF is a leading producer of high-quality kitchen products made in Germany, featuring collections like Function 4, Profi Plus, and Boston. The site showcases their full product range from cookware and knives to coffee machines and dining accessories, with seasonal promotions and exclusive direct-from-manufacturer offerings.
